versions.changelog:
Initial release of hermes-desktop-customization skill.

- Provides guidance for customizing Hermes Desktop source (titlebar, fonts, icons).
- Details key source file locations and sizing controls for UI elements.
- Outlines best practices: always research and plan before editing, verify changes via git.
- Documents update and verification procedures to ensure customizations survive app updates.
- Lists common pitfalls (e.g., hardcoded height values, zoom-related issues).
- Emphasizes not to confuse source patching with the plugin system.
